name: J850 Pro
summary: Multi-material, full-colour PolyJet for design validation and realistic prototypes.

page.description: Stratasys J850 Pro 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: A functional, engineering-grade
page.lead: Up to seven materials in one print, with 14-micron detail for final checks and a 55-micron Super High Speed mode for fast concept iterations.
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com J850 Pro page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Up to seven materials
features.text: Functional digital material combinations in one model.

features.title: Super High Speed
features.text: 55 µm drafts for early concept iterations.

features.title: GrabCAD Print
features.text: Direct CAD import, colour matching and job management.

benefits.title: Lower cost
benefits.text: Prototyping cost cut by more than 80 % (Stratasys claim).

specs.label: Print modes
specs.value: High Quality: up to 7 resins, 14 µm · High Mix: up to 7 resins, 27 µm · High Speed: up to 3 resins, 27 µm · Super High Speed: 1 resin, 55 µm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: Under 100 mm: ±100 µm. Over 100 mm: ±200 µm or ±0.06 % of part length, whichever is greater (typical, rigid materials)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: ToughONE, DraftGrey, Digital ABS Plus, Agilus30, VeroUltra Clear

page.applications_heading: Functional prototypes across the development cycle.

applications.title: Automotive parts
applications.text: ABS-like durability and a range of Shore values for fit checks.
